title: Cushion Solitaire Ring
descriptionHtml:
A long cushion of light, framed in gold. One elongated cushion cut clear cubic zirconia, about 14mm by 9mm, set low in a thin polished gold rim and laid lengthways along the finger on a plain fine band. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8.

STYLING TIP: Let it be the only ring on that hand.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Stone: Elongated cushion cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 14mm by 9mm
  • Setting: Thin polished gold rim
  • Band: Plain polished, approximately 2mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
